authority: Close the Shatter-to-heavy-Attack relay without implementation or simulator spend and continue with the next evidence-backed structural mechanism inside issue #421. Do not weaken, subset or retune this screen.

candidate.claimBoundary: A capacity pass authorises only research-knob implementation and null/mediator identity preflight. Existing-row co-occurrence is not temporal activation, complementarity, outcome benefit, content admission or product scope.
candidate.consumer: The next reward-pool Attack with printed cost at least 2 consumes the charge only when the charge reduces its effective Energy cost by exactly 1.
candidate.mechanisticJustification: Shatter already represents the Duskblade breaking facets into fuel, while a three-Energy turn makes printed-cost-2-or-3 reward Attacks the narrow consumer class. The relay therefore tests temporal conversion of the aspect's existing producer into a selective heavy-Attack repertoire rather than another Shatter scalar.
candidate.payoff: Exactly 1 Energy saved; no damage, Ward, draw, healing, chip, rarity, offer, acquisition or policy-score change is part of this family.
candidate.producer: One real Duskblade Shatter arms at most one relay charge after the triggering Attack has resolved.
candidate.scope: Duskblade only. A charge is capped at one, does not stack, survives only inside the current combat and does not consume when another effect has already reduced the eligible Attack to zero.
candidate.structuralSeparation: The producer/consumer grammar contains neither Chisel nor Faultline, does not read Scoreline, Ward, Afterimage or Kindle, and cannot fire for Ashwarden.
